h1: The 7 Best LG TVs of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 7 best LG TVs of 2026, from C5 and C6 OLED evo models to QNED Mini LED and a 75 inch Nano set.
summary: The 65 inch LG C5 OLED evo is our top pick for a living room, with the C6 as the newer alternative. The 55 inch C5 and C6 suit smaller rooms. The QNED73 is the cheapest way into a Mini LED LG, and the 75 inch NU85 is the choice for a large room on a tighter panel budget.
intro: LG sells a confusing ladder of letters: OLED, QNED, Nano. The panel type matters far more than the model number, and buying the wrong rung is the most common LG mistake.

We ranked seven sets from the listing details: panel type, screen size, series and audio features. Differences within a panel family are small on paper, so the real decision is OLED versus Mini LED versus Nano, then size.

products.name: LG 65-Inch Class OLED evo AI 4K C5 Series Smart TV w/Dolby Atmos
products.verdict: The 65 inch OLED evo C5 is the sensible centre of LG's range.
products.description:
This is a 65 inch OLED evo set in the C5 series, with 4K resolution, AI features and Dolby Atmos support. It sits in the $500+ bracket, like every OLED here.

It takes first place over the C6 because the C5 is the established model, while the C6 above it in the line is the newer series with the same listed feature set. On paper the two are close, so the choice often comes down to which is available.

Buy it for a living room of average size. The caveat is that a 65 inch OLED is a big purchase, and the listing gives no detail on brightness.
products.idealFor: A mid-size living room that wants LG's best panel type.
products.skipIf: You are working to a strict budget.

products.name: LG 65-Inch Class OLED evo AI 4K C6 Series Smart TV w/Dolby Atmos
products.verdict: The C6 is the same recipe as the C5, one series newer.
products.description:
The C6 is a 65 inch OLED evo set with 4K resolution, AI features and Dolby Atmos, matching the C5's listed specs. It also sits in the $500+ bracket.

It lands one place below the C5 because the listing offers no additional spec we can point to as an upgrade. The 55 inch C6 below it trades size for a smaller footprint.

Good for buyers who prefer the latest series number. Caveat: do not pay a premium for the newer name without a stated feature to justify it.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want the newest series in the 65 inch size.
products.skipIf: A C5 is cheaper when you check price.

products.name: LG 55-Inch Class OLED evo AI 4K C5 Series Smart TV w/Dolby Atmos
products.verdict: The same OLED evo C5 in a size that fits a bedroom.
products.description:
A 55 inch OLED evo in the C5 series with 4K, AI features and Dolby Atmos. It is in the $500+ bracket.

It comes third because the 65 inch versions give more screen for the same panel family. It beats the QNED sets below because OLED is the stronger panel type.

Pick it for bedrooms and smaller living rooms. Caveat: at 55 inches, you are paying OLED prices for a screen size that cheaper panels also offer.

products.name: LG 55-Inch Class OLED evo AI 4K C6 Series Smart TV w/Dolby Atmos
products.verdict: The newer-series take on the 55 inch OLED.
products.description:
This 55 inch C6 OLED evo has 4K resolution, AI features and Dolby Atmos. It sits in the $500+ bracket.

It follows the C5 55 inch because the listing shows no added spec for the newer series. It outranks the QNED models since OLED is a higher panel tier.

Best for buyers who want a small, current-series OLED. Caveat: confirm the price gap against the C5 before choosing it.
products.idealFor: Small rooms where you want the current series.

products.name: LG 55-Inch Class QNED evo AI QNED84B Series Mini LED 4K Smart TV
products.verdict: A Mini LED alternative for buyers who want to skip OLED.
products.description:
The QNED84B is a 55 inch QNED evo Mini LED 4K set, in the $500+ bracket.

It ranks above the QNED73 because the evo label points to a higher tier in LG's QNED range. It sits below the OLEDs, which are LG's top panel type.

A fit for bright rooms where you prefer Mini LED. Caveat: it costs about the same as the OLEDs above, so the case for it is narrower.
products.idealFor: Bright rooms where you prefer Mini LED.
products.skipIf: An OLED is within your budget.

products.name: LG Amazon Exclusive 55-Inch Class QNED AI 4K QNED73 Series Mini LED
products.verdict: The cheapest Mini LED LG in this ranking.
products.description:
This is a 55 inch QNED Mini LED 4K set, an Amazon-exclusive model in the $200-500 bracket, the only set here below $500.

It ranks below the QNED84B because it lacks the evo label. It beats the Nano set on panel type and sits where budget matters most.

Pick it if price is the priority. Caveat: being an Amazon exclusive, it may be harder to compare against retail models.
products.idealFor: Budget buyers who still want a Mini LED LG.

products.name: LG 75-Inch Class Nano AI 4K NU85 Series Smart TV w/AI Sound Pro
products.verdict: The only 75 inch set in the group, with a lower panel tier.
products.description:
The NU85 is a 75 inch Nano 4K set with AI Sound Pro, in the $500+ bracket.

It ranks last on panel tier, since Nano sits below QNED and OLED in this lineup. Its draw is size, as it is the largest screen here.

Best for large living rooms. Caveat: the listing names no Mini LED or OLED technology.
products.idealFor: Large rooms that prioritize screen size.
products.skipIf: Picture quality matters more than size.

methodology.title: Panel type
methodology.description: OLED evo, QNED Mini LED and Nano form a clear ladder, and we ranked within it.

methodology.title: Screen size
methodology.description: We matched 55, 65 and 75 inch sets to typical room sizes.

methodology.title: Audio features
methodology.description: Dolby Atmos and AI Sound Pro were noted where listed.

methodology.title: Series generation
methodology.description: C5 and C6 sets were compared on stated specs, not model-year assumptions.

methodology.title: Price bracket
methodology.description: We weighed each set against its price bucket, from $200-500 to $500+.

whatMatters.detail: OLED lights each pixel individually, while Mini LED uses a backlight with many small zones. This decides contrast and brightness. Check the title for OLED, QNED or Nano before comparing anything else.
A bigger screen only helps if you sit far enough back. A 55 inch set suits a bedroom, a 65 inch a typical living room, and a 75 inch a large room. Measure your seating distance before choosing.
Series such as C5 and C6 indicate the model generation. Newer is not automatically better, since specs can match. Compare the listed features, not the number.
Dolby Atmos and AI Sound Pro describe the built-in sound processing. They help if you do not use a soundbar. Look for them in the title or bullet points.
A set in a lower bracket makes a compromise somewhere, often panel tier. Use the bracket as a quick screen. Confirm the current price on the listing.

howToChoose.intro: Pick a screen to suit where it will sit.

cards.label: OLED
cards.text: Individually lit pixels and LG's top tier. The C5 and C6 in 55 and 65 inch sizes.

cards.label: Mini LED
cards.text: A backlit panel suited to bright rooms. The QNED73 and QNED84B.

howToChoose.note: Most buyers should default to OLED unless the room is very bright or the budget is tight.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: OLED panels and Dolby Atmos support.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The 65 inch C5 offers both and is our top pick.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You watch in a dim room. The C5 OLED evo is worth the move up from QNED.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: Your room is bright. The QNED73 is the one LG here priced below $500.

faq.q: What does evo mean on an LG OLED?
faq.a: It is LG's label for its higher OLED tier. The listing for these C-series sets names it in the title.

faq.q: Is the C6 better than the C5?
faq.a: The listings show matching headline specs, so the gap on paper is small. Compare price before paying extra.

faq.q: Is OLED worth it over Mini LED?
faq.a: In dim rooms, OLED is the stronger panel type. In bright rooms, a Mini LED set makes more sense.
The C5 and C6 OLED evo sets list Dolby Atmos. The NU85 lists AI Sound Pro instead.
55 inch suits a bedroom, 65 inch a typical living room, and 75 inch a large room.

faq.q: What is the NU85 Nano set?
faq.a: It is a 75 inch 4K set at a lower panel tier than QNED or OLED, aimed at buyers who want size.

finalTake: The 65 inch LG C5 OLED evo is the safe bet for most households. Choose the C6 only if its price is close. If you are on a budget, the QNED73 is the one LG here priced below $500, and the NU85 is for rooms that need size above all.
